description: This file defines the ScreenFactory class for the OFBiz widget model package, responsible for loading, retrieving, and rendering screen definitions from XML files or web application context, including caching mechanisms and utility methods for parsing combined location-name strings.

classes.name: ScreenFactory
classes.description: Factory class for loading, caching, and rendering screen models from XML resources and web context, including parsing combined identifiers and managing screen cache.

methods.name: isCombinedName
methods.description: Checks if a combined name string contains a '#' separator indicating a combined location and screen name.

methods.name: getResourceNameFromCombined
methods.description: Extracts the resource location part from a combined name string.

methods.name: getScreenNameFromCombined
methods.description: Extracts the screen name part from a combined name string.

methods.name: getScreenFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelScreen object based on a combined resource and screen name string.

methods.name: getScreenFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelScreen given explicit resource name and screen name.

methods.name: getScreensFromLocation
methods.description: Loads and caches all screens from a given resource location, returning a map of screen names to ModelScreen objects.

methods.name: getScreenFromWebappContext
methods.description: Loads a specific ModelScreen from a web application's context, using the resource name and screen name, with caching based on webapp name.

methods.name: readScreenDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document containing screen definitions and constructs a map of screen names to ModelScreen objects.

methods.name: renderReferencedScreen
methods.description: Renders a referenced screen by name and location or from the current parent widget, handling combined names and errors.
